core_obligations: By the hom-systems-ML lemma the inverse system (Isom_A(M_n, N_n)) over n is Mittag-Leffler (proof lines 29132-29133). Each set is nonempty by the hypothesis M_n = N_n for all n, and a Mittag-Leffler inverse system of nonempty sets has nonempty limit, so lim Isom_A(M_n, N_n) is nonempty (proof lines 29134-29135). The limit of the isomorphism sets is naturally the set Isom_{A^wedge}(M^wedge, N^wedge), so M^wedge and N^wedge are isomorphic as A^wedge-modules (proof lines 29135-29137).
proof_roadmap: Get the Mittag-Leffler property and nonemptiness of each isomorphism set (proof lines 29132-29134).
Take the nonempty limit and identify it with Isom of the completions (proof lines 29134-29137).
